info.name: DevBench Backend
info.description: Covers all implemented modules: Auth, User, Problem Bank, Company. Login requests auto-save accessToken/refreshToken into collection variables for chained requests.

request.description: Creates the user immediately with emailVerified: false and emails a 6-digit OTP. Returns { email, otpExpiresInSeconds } — NOT tokens. Copy the OTP from your mail catcher/logs into registrationOtp, then run 'Verify Email' below before logging in.

Creates the user immediately with emailVerified: false and emails a 6-digit OTP. Returns { email, otpExpiresInSeconds } — NOT tokens. Copy the OTP from your mail catcher/logs into registrationOtp, then run 'Verify Email' below before logging in.
Sets emailVerified: true, sends the welcome email, and returns tokens — login will 403 with 'please verify your email' until this succeeds.

Postman can't run the Google consent flow itself — obtain a real Google ID token from a frontend/OAuth playground first and paste it into googleIdToken. role/companyName are only used the first time a given Google account signs in; ignored on subsequent logins.
Only works for a verified, non-Google account (404/403 otherwise). Copy the OTP from your mail catcher/logs into resetPasswordOtp before running 'Reset Password' below.
On success, log in again with the new password to get a fresh accessToken — this endpoint doesn't return tokens itself.
Body token is only needed if cookies aren't being used by the client. Postman will also send the refreshToken cookie automatically if login was called in the same session.

item.name: Create Problem (MCQ) - Company Owner
item.description: Expect 201. Verifies the COMPANY_OWNER RBAC fix.

item.name: Get Problem By Id - Assessment Creator

request.description: Set otherCompanyProblemId to a problem id owned by a different company (e.g. create one while logged in as a second COMPANY_OWNER). Confirms the IDOR fix.

item.name: Get Assessment By Id - Assessment Creator
Attach Problem to Assessment - Assessment Creator

request.description: Requires a valid problemId collection variable — run 'Create Problem' in the Problem Bank folder first.
Step 1 of 2: creates an assessment with no problems attached, capturing its id into emptyAssessmentId.
Step 2 of 2: run the 'zero problems' create request above first, then run this.
Run this AFTER sending at least one invitation for this assessment (see Invitation folder) to confirm the edit-lock.
Set otherCompanyAssessmentId to an assessment id owned by a different company to confirm companyId scoping.

exec: // Copy the token from the invite email/logs into invitationToken to test accept flow

request.description: Assessment must be PUBLISHED first. Debits 1 credit from the company's balance.

item.name: Get All Invitations for Assessment - Company Owner

request.description: No Authorization header — creates a new CANDIDATE account from the invited email.
Requires the logged-in candidate's email to exactly match the invitation's candidateEmail.

item.name: [Negative] Invite to a DRAFT assessment -> expect 400

request.description: Uses the unpublished emptyAssessmentId from the Assessment folder's negative tests.
Run the 'Send Invitation' request above twice with the same email to trigger this.

item.name: [Negative] Send invite with zero credit balance -> expect 400

request.description: Only meaningful once the seeded company's creditBalance has been exhausted by prior sends.
Run this again after invitationToken has already been accepted once.
Requires an ACCEPTED invitation for this candidate on this assessment (see Invitation folder). Calling this again while IN_PROGRESS resumes the same attempt rather than creating a new one.
Response should contain no isCorrect fields on mcqOptions and no hidden test cases — verify this manually when checking the response.
problemId must be attached to this attempt's assessment. mcqOptionId — copy a real McqOption id from the 'Get Attempt' response's problems[].problem.mcqOptions array.

item.name: [Negative] Submit CODING fields to an MCQ problem -> expect 400

request.description: Confirms the reject-wrong-fields-for-type rule — sending code/language for an MCQ problem should fail, not silently ignore the mismatch.
MCQ answers auto-grade immediately. CODING/WRITTEN answers with content go to PENDING_REVIEW. totalScore stays null until nothing is pending.
Attempt is already SUBMITTED at this point — expect a 400, not a silent overwrite.

item.name: [Negative] Start attempt without an accepted invitation -> expect 403

request.description: Uses a non-invited account to confirm the invitation-required gate. Swap the token for any account without an ACCEPTED invitation on this assessment.
Auto-captures the first pending submissionResultId, if any exist — run a CODING/WRITTEN submission through Attempt's final-submit first to populate this queue.
Unlike the candidate-facing attempt view, this exposes hidden test cases and isCorrect — intentional, evaluators need the full picture.
Run this again after 'Grade Submission' above already succeeded once — grading is final per the Day 4 decision.
Use a fresh, still-PENDING_REVIEW submissionResultId for this test since the one above may already be graded.
Set otherCompanySubmissionResultId to a pending submission belonging to a different company's assessment to confirm companyId scoping through the submission -> attempt -> assessment chain.
Any authenticated user with no companyId yet can call this; it promotes them to COMPANY_OWNER. Expect 400 if the token belongs to a user who already has a companyId (e.g. the seeded company owner).

item.name: [Negative] Update My Company - Assessment Creator -> expect 403

request.description: Sends an email with the invite link. Copy the token from the emailed link (or your mail catcher/logs) into the teamInviteToken collection variable.

item.name: [Negative] Invite Team Member - Assessment Creator -> expect 403

request.description: Registers + joins in one step for someone with no existing account. For an existing logged-in user accepting instead, send this with an Authorization header and an empty body.
